kind: Static/source design review only; no rendered/current-browser audit

triage.gradient: Legacy neutral photo/hero scrims; source rule lacks current-render/exception context. Preserve selected design; no automatic CSS fix.
triage.shadow: Selected inset/focus/panel and overlay/Bklit contexts; raw matches are not demonstrated misplaced shadows.
triage.glass: Selected shell/rail/popover/tooltip material. Requires rendered comparison, not global removal.
triage.framework-colour: Selected status tone variables/names in workspace-status.css; not evidence of an unauthorized palette.
triage.scale-zero: False positive: numeric chart scale(0) locates its data baseline; it is not a CSS transform.
triage.bounce: Standard shadcn loading Skeleton animate-pulse; global reduced-motion rules exist; not an ornamental attention badge.
triage.numbering: False positives: two-decimal finance formatting and canonical PDF model code 01.
